comments.text:
Fascinating how Doctor Mike (obviously) turns to towards direct physical illness and medication side effects when judging the case.
With the case at 1:25, I was ready to see how a proper doctor proceeds with diagnosing from symptoms as vague as "poor sleep and difficulty concentrating".  But the moment the second hint phrased "she says it's just stress" as a deflection rather than actual explanation, and specifically calling out she refuses to get into specific triggers, I suspected something psychological instead. Not specifically PTSD from the second hint only, but definitely something much more intimate, personal and difficult to open up about than just "Benadryl sideeffects".

I guess it speaks to how we make assumptions based on what we most commonly deal with.
comments.author: @Haccoude
